assumptions: A sweep takes seconds, so a port carrying a 9.6 kHz signal reads as an arbitrary sample, not a waveform. `volatile` means the port moved between reads, not that it is audio.
Ports are read one at a time and never simultaneously, so nothing here relates two ports' values at one instant.
`constant` is only constant across the states sampled here; the modem was never off hook and never on a call.
Reading a mailbox port may consume state the firmware was about to read, so its values are not purely observational.
